## TRA Timeline

#### Form-of filed at Cox Transaction Agreement signing

- 2025-05-16: Cox Transaction Agreement signed and filed as Exhibit 2.1 to 8-K; Form-of Amended and Restated Tax Receivables Agreement attached as Exhibit G inside Exhibit 2.1
- 2025-08-18: Pro forma 8-K confirms 50% TRA payment rate carried over from the 2016 TRA
- 2025-09-02: Note offering 8-K incorporates Form-of TRA by reference; DEFM14A also reproduces it

## Explanation

This contract is a form-of (unexecuted) Amended and Restated Tax Receivables Agreement attached as Exhibit G to the May 16, 2025 Cox Transaction Agreement; it will replace the 2016 TRA at the Cox Transactions closing. The economic structure carries over from the 2016 TRA at 50%, the covered tax attribute is the same Section 754 basis adjustments from Taxable Exchanges, and A/N continues as a TRA Party; Cox Enterprises is added as a second TRA Party covering its Class C Common Units and convertible preferred units. The preamble date is blank in the form-of and will be the Cox closing date; the directory differentiator `cox-form` reflects that the document is not yet executed. Once the Cox Transactions close, this contract should be treated as a continuation of `TRA-2016-05-18` rather than a parallel TRA. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
